entries.title: T1053.003: Scheduled Task/Job: Cron
entries.description: Adversaries may abuse the `cron` utility to execute malicious code on a recurring schedule or at system startup to establish persistence and maintain access to compromised Linux systems.

entries.title: T1105: Ingress Tool Transfer
entries.description: Adversaries may transfer tools or other files from an external system (e.g., C2 infrastructure or public repositories) into a compromised host environment.
